{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Confirm: are there any rows with revenue = '999999.99'?
qa_rows = data[data['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print("QA test order rows found:", len(qa_rows))
print("QA test order rows:", qa_rows)

# Since no such rows exist, we can proceed without filtering for them
# But we must still exclude refunded orders and keep only email channel

# Clean revenue
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter: email channel, completed status
email_completed = data[(data['channel'] == 'email') & (data['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute average revenue
avg_revenue_email = email_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print result
print(f"Average revenue for email channel, completed orders: {avg_revenue_email:.2f}")

# Store
result = avg_revenue_email"}
